questions.answer: I got the classes I wanted but was disappointed by the level.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Speak to the professors, it is way more common to have a relation to them, let them help you find something on your level. There is a tendency that everything is called more advanced, hard, cutting-egde. This is generally not the case, just american being very hyped compared to europeans.

questions.answer: Took "introduction to time series" on level 5000 and "applied deep learning" also on level 5000. Couse load was 10 hours a week. Dont be scared of taking lvl 6000/7000, if you are smart. I was on applied math. I don't know anything about the other engienering classes.
